Coach concepts · closed files

Closed files contain pawns of both colors. Actual slider rays stop at the first unit; complete legal file moves after every reply retain captures, pins, checks and lost sliders. No disadvantage or permanent-blockage claim. Full proofs are retained in results.json. Authored positions; no extension integration.

Forks need a capture witness against every legal reply, with positive nominal material after immediate counterreplies. This finite check does not establish the best move or a winning position. Praise and strategic advice await broader validation.

Full canonical certificates and every legal reply

Earlier endgame and trade examples · Tactical and structural examples · Inherited cases are checked and fingerprinted in results.json.
